notes: Makeshift Battalion, printed: 'Whenever this creature and at least two other creatures attack, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' It is 'at least' two: with THREE other creatures attacking (four attackers) there is exactly one trigger and one counter (not one for each extra attacker). The opponent takes 4 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 10 (20 -> 10).
